items.title: International Paper (IP) Stock Fair Value Rises After Split Analyst Calls On Containerboard Pricing
items.summary: International Paper now carries a higher fair value estimate, moving from US$39.36 to US$43.64, which signals an updated view on where the stock may be reasonably priced. This change sits alongside a mixed set of analyst opinions, with some pointing to higher price targets tied to containerboard pricing and others stepping back to more neutral stances as they weigh demand and cost pressures. items.title: IP Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Decline Y/Y on High Maintenance Costs
items.summary: International Paper beats adjusted earnings estimates despite a profit slump as maintenance outages hurt margins, while outlining third-quarter EBITDA targets and 2026 guidance.

items.title: IP’s box volumes rise, but external conditions mute demand
items.summary: International Paper expects geopolitical and economic conditions to offset some gains from recent price increases. Executives updated progress on the company’s split and four North American investments.

items.title: International Paper (NYSE:IP) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings
items.summary: Packaging and materials company International Paper (NYSE:IP) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 11.3% year on year to $6.00 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.04 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
